intro: This errand marks the triumphant conclusion of the campaign against the Cult of the Dark Strand at the Tower of Althalaxx. Having eliminated the cult's leadership within the sinister ruins of Darkshore, an adventurer carries word south into Ashenvale to Delgren the Purifier. It represents a vital victory for the Alliance in purging demonic corruption from the ancient night elven borders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For all the work that you have done, you deserve to be well rewarded. Return to Delgren and tell him that Athrikus Narassin lies stilled by your hand, and the Cult of the Dark Strand is beaten and scattered.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I knew you would be up to the task, friend.
I sense great deeds before you, and that you will right many of the wrongs that plague our lands. Bear my blessings, friend, as well as this gift.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
